slot_scores.name: missing_minimize_hours_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total hours worked by the selected workers (i.e., the sum of the hours for the four assigned tasks), or is there a different objective such as minimizing the maximum hours any single worker works?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total hours worked, directly covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since there are 4 tasks and exactly 4 workers are selected, does each selected worker perform exactly one task (a one-to-one assignment), or could a selected worker perform multiple tasks while another selected worker performs none?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each selected worker performs exactly one task or could perform multiple tasks, fully covering the hidden constraint.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 and P1 hidden slots were explicitly asked and confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both hidden slots, confirming the minimization objective and the one-task-per-selected-worker constraint before stopping appropriately.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
